tasks.short: Enter, classify, post, and review financial transactions in accounting records.

steps.what: Import transaction records and locate missing supporting documents.
Assign account codes, cost centres, tax codes, and accounting periods.
Resolve unusual coding and approve entries requiring supervisory authority.
Post authorised transactions and retain references to supporting documents.
Review account movements and identify balances needing investigation.

tasks.design: Use existing rules in the {ERP} for coding and posting, with a deterministic connector linking transaction records to evidence in the {DOCS}. Route unusual entries to the accounting supervisor and use the {ERP} reporting view to prioritise balance investigations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disconnected imports, incomplete coding rules, and missing document references left clerks joining records by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing posting controls handle much of the work. AI-assisted coding makes the remaining connectors and validation rules cheaper to build.
tasks.still_hard: Unusual transactions, period cut-offs, and inconsistent master data still need accounting judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a technically valid entry misrepresents the business event and obtain the missing context.

ambition.what: Daily prioritisation of unexplained account movements

tasks.altitude: The clerk spends less time entering records and more time investigating account movements. With delegated authority, they choose which discrepancies to investigate first; posting exceptions remain with the supervisor.

reach.task: Prepare account movement explanations for the monthly close.
reach.learn: Accruals, cut-off rules, materiality, and evidence supporting an explanation.

evidence.claim: Accounting systems support configured posting rules, document references, and account reports; connector feasibility depends on access.
AFAS Profit documents automatic bank matching using references, IBAN, or invoice numbers, with unmatched items handled by people.
AI-assisted coding can reduce connector development effort; this design has no measured speedup.

assumptions: These shares describe an illustrative transaction cycle, including supervisory time, rather than a measured clerk-only time study.
The {ERP} remains the financial system of record.
Routine posting uses approved rules, open-period checks, duplicate controls, and existing authority limits.
The structured-input prior is plausible; judgement remains concentrated in exceptions and balance review.
Build ranges cover one entity and a limited set of transaction sources.
unknowns: Available {ERP} import interfaces and configuration rights.
Current coding coverage, exception volumes, and document completeness.
Posting thresholds, segregation of duties, and permitted clerk decision rights.
Whether access changes trigger employee consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Can existing {ERP} configuration cover recurring coding before a connector is built?
How will retries avoid duplicate postings and preserve document references?
Which historical exceptions reveal gaps in the coding rules?
new_work: Review missing documents and unmapped transactions.
Maintain coding rules and source mappings.
Monitor failed imports and duplicate controls.
Sample automatic postings and retain correction history.

tasks.short: Check financial entries against documents, recalculate amounts, verify codes, and correct errors.

steps.what: Compare posted values with invoices and other supporting documents.

loop.input: Non-structured supporting documents and the corresponding ledger fields.
loop.output: Source-linked amounts, dates, identifiers, and proposed document discrepancies.
loop.check: Validate field types, document locations, totals, currency, and record identity; ambiguous fields remain unresolved.
loop.stop: One extraction and one targeted retry per document; unresolved fields go to the accounting clerk.
loop.why_not_simpler: Use structured records and templates first; varied document layouts leave some fields requiring bounded extraction.

steps.what: Recalculate totals, tax amounts, and debit-credit balance.
Check account, tax, cost-centre, and period codes against approved rules.
Prepare corrections and enter those within delegated authority.
Approve corrections outside clerk authority and sign off unresolved findings.

tasks.design: Configure arithmetic and coding checks in the {ERP}, linking each finding to evidence in the {DOCS}. Add bounded extraction only for non-structured documents, then prepare traceable correction entries that take effect after the appropriate clerk or supervisor approves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Arithmetic was easy to automate, but document variation and incomplete coding rules kept comparisons manual.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing controls cover structured checks. Bounded extraction can supply document fields while deterministic checks verify their consistency.
tasks.still_hard: A matching total can still hide a wrong period, inappropriate tax treatment, or misleading business description.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a harmless mismatch from an accounting error and explain why a correction is justified.

ambition.what: Weekly recurring-error analysis for transaction originators

tasks.altitude: The clerk reviews exceptions and identifies recurring error sources instead of repeating arithmetic. They can recommend upstream fixes; approval limits for financial corrections stay explicit.

reach.task: Prepare a control finding with evidence and a proposed remedy.
reach.learn: Control objectives, sampling, materiality, and root-cause analysis.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit documents invoice extraction and supplier identification using company registration, VAT number, and IBAN.
Medius AP Automation performs line-level matching of invoices, purchase orders, and receipts.
The Huuskes vendor case documents increased automatic invoice processing; it does not establish savings for general ledger checking.
Document extraction needs source checks and exception handling; general accounting classification remains context-dependent.

assumptions: Time shares and remaining percentages are design estimates, including supervisor effort.
Structured document fields bypass the model loop.
Automatic checks detect candidate errors; corrections preserve an audit trail.
The high automation prior fits arithmetic better than contextual code verification.
GDPR safeguards apply to personal data in documents; relevant EU AI Act literacy duties apply to model use.
unknowns: Document formats, languages, scan quality, and structured invoice coverage.
Existing validation rules and correction permissions.
Permitted processing location, retention, and access for confidential documents.
Whether employee-data processing changes require consultation under national rules.
research_questions: Which checks already exist but are disabled in the {ERP}?
How accurately does extraction perform on representative difficult documents?
Which correction types require supervisor approval regardless of amount?
new_work: Review ambiguous extractions and proposed corrections.
Maintain validation rules and document mappings.
Investigate false alarms and missed errors.
Monitor model changes, access, and document retention.

tasks.short: Follow applicable accounting rules, company controls, and European and national requirements.

steps.what: Consult current policies and applicable accounting or regulatory instructions.
Apply established authorisation, documentation, tax, and period controls.
Assemble supporting evidence and record the control performed.
Discuss uncertain requirements and decide the permitted response with appropriate specialist advice.
Record the decision and notify the responsible transaction owner.

tasks.design: Index approved, dated instructions in the {DOCS} and configure established controls in the {ERP}. Generate evidence packs and use the {WORKFLOW} to route exceptions, record human decisions, and notify internal owners.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policies were separate from transaction controls, and evidence collection depended on clerks remembering each requirement.
tasks.enabler_now: Versioned document indexes, configured controls, and deterministic evidence assembly are already feasible. Cheaper connector development makes them practical to combine.
tasks.still_hard: Legal interpretation, conflicting requirements, and policy changes require qualified judgement and accountable decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Notice when following a checklist would defeat the control's purpose and escalate with a clear explanation.
tasks.altitude: The clerk spends less time finding instructions and assembling evidence, with more time explaining exceptions. They gain no legal or policy approval authority.

reach.task: Prepare a factual exception brief for a control or regulatory review.
reach.learn: Rule applicability, evidence quality, escalation thresholds, and the limits of clerk authority.

evidence.claim: Approved instruction indexes, configured transaction controls, and evidence assembly can support compliance without automating legal interpretation.
The EU ViDA directive changes VAT rules for digital reporting and invoicing; applicability must be mapped to the entity and effective dates.
Dutch works-council rules include consent rights for certain employee-data and monitoring arrangements; other countries have different national rules.
The EU AI Act lists worker monitoring and natural-person creditworthiness uses in Annex III; intended use matters when assessing a system.

assumptions: This task covers ongoing transaction compliance, rather than owning all regulatory filings.
Time shares include manager consultation and are illustrative.
Only approved, sufficiently explicit rules become automatic controls.
The human-heavy prior applies to interpretation; routine checking and paperwork can still change.
GDPR applies to personal data. Employee consultation and employment requirements depend on national rules.
Access and consultation ranges allow for review of the proposed processing; statutory procedures may extend elapsed rollout time.
unknowns: Countries, legal entities, transaction types, and sector requirements.
Current policy owners, effective versions, and escalation routes.
Whether proposed controls process employee data or introduce employee monitoring.
Applicable consultation requirements and approval timelines.
research_questions: Which obligations can be expressed as testable controls without losing their meaning?
How will changed instructions retire old rules and preserve historical evidence?
What data processing and intended uses require GDPR or EU AI Act assessment?
new_work: Maintain instruction versions and rule applicability.
Review control changes with accounting and compliance specialists.
Handle exceptions and retain decision evidence.
Review access, retention, and applicable consultation commitments.

tasks.short: Perform residual manual calculations, prepare finance documents, and handle paper copies.

steps.what: Read amounts from source documents for a calculation or finance document.
Use a desk calculator to total amounts or check a calculation.
Type a finance document using a standard template.
Print or copy the document for a paper file or recipient.
File the copy and retain any original that must remain physical.

tasks.design: Use verified values from the {ERP} to calculate results and populate fixed templates in the {DOCS}. Retain approved documents digitally, remove routine duplicate paper copies, and keep physical handling only for originals that require it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Small document workflows were low priorities, while disconnected templates and local paper habits kept retyping alive.
tasks.enabler_now: Calculation functions and document templates already exist. AI-assisted coding lowers the effort of connecting verified records to those templates.
tasks.still_hard: Poor source data, unusual document wording, and genuinely required physical originals remain exceptions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unsuitable template or unreliable source and handle required physical originals correctly.
tasks.altitude: The clerk has fewer interruptions for calculations, typing, and copying. Nothing changes in their financial decision rights.

reach.task: Maintain a verified finance-document template and its source-field mapping.
reach.learn: Document requirements, field validation, version control, and retention rules.

evidence.claim: Standard calculation functions and fixed document templates can replace calculator work and retyping without a model.
In a typical mid-size European company, this legacy task is more likely to involve occasional calculators and copying than typewriters.
Digital filing can replace convenience copies where applicable retention requirements allow it.

assumptions: Shares describe the residual manual workflow when it occurs, not its prevalence across the whole job.
Typewriter use is not assumed to be typical.
Working values already exist as verified fields in the {ERP}; unsupported documents remain exceptions.
Routine paper copies are convenience copies; required paper handling remains in the final step.
The low automation prior is rejected for arithmetic and retyping, which use established deterministic methods.
GDPR governs personal-data access and retention; national rules may require particular originals or consultation.
unknowns: Actual calculator, printing, and copying volumes.
Which documents have structured source values and fixed templates.
Which physical originals must be retained and for how long.
Whether recipient requirements prevent digital delivery or filing.
research_questions: Can existing {ERP} reports produce these documents without custom code?
Which paper copies can be removed after checking retention and recipient requirements?
Which template fields need validation before a document is retained?
new_work: Maintain templates, calculations, and source-field mappings.
Handle missing data and unusual wording.
Maintain the list of required physical originals.

role.altitude: The role shifts from repeated entry and checking toward exception investigation, evidence preparation, and recurring-error analysis. Clerks can gain authority to prioritise investigations and recommend process fixes; financial approvals and legal interpretation require explicit delegation.
reach: Accountants and Auditors: account explanations and evidence-backed control findings.
Compliance Officers: factual exception briefs and control evidence.
Billing and Posting Clerks: reliable document templates and source mappings.
skills_to_grow: Accounting cut-off, materiality, and contextual coding.
Control design, audit trails, and segregation of duties.
Data validation, template maintenance, and connector monitoring.
GDPR-aware evidence handling and bounded-model output review.
role.ambitious_version: A finance operations analyst who prioritises unexplained balances daily and produces weekly recurring-error findings that help transaction owners prevent mistakes, while working within explicit correction and approval limits.
